req.title: Include origin IP in echoed metadata
req.statement: The system shall include the client origin (X-Forwarded-For if present, else remote_addr) in the 'origin' field of all echo endpoints.
triggers: include origin ip in echoed metadata

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that all echo endpoints (/get, /post, /put, /patch, /delete) must include the client origin IP in the 'origin' field, preferring X-Forwarded-For if present, else falling back to remote_addr. The key logic is in get_dict() in helpers.py: `origin=request.headers.get('X-Forwarded-For', request.remote_addr)`. Tests must cover: (1) positive - remote_addr used when no X-Forwarded-For header, (2) positive - X-Forwarded-For takes precedence when present, (3) negative - absence of origin field would be a failure, (4) boundary - X-Forwarded-For with multiple IPs (comma-separated), (5) decision table covering all five endpoints, (6) boundary - empty vs non-empty X-Forwarded-For. Mutation targets: the `get` vs `get(..., default)` call, the header name string 'X-Forwarded-For', the field name 'origin', and the fallback to remote_addr.

tests.name: test_get_origin_uses_remote_addr_when_no_xff
actions: Check 'origin' field equals the test client remote_addr (127.0.0.1)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: origin field must use remote_addr when X-Forwarded-For absent
helpers.py: origin=request.headers.get('X-Forwarded-For', request.remote_addr)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_origin_uses_remote_addr_when_no_xff():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert data['origin'] == '127.0.0.1'

test_get_origin_uses_remote_addr_when_no_xff()

tests.name: test_get_origin_uses_xff_when_present
preconditions: X-Forwarded-For header is set to a specific IP
trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: X-Forwarded-For takes precedence over remote_addr
helpers.py: request.headers.get('X-Forwarded-For', request.remote_addr)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_origin_uses_xff_when_present():
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'X-Forwarded-For': '203.0.113.42'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert data['origin'] == '203.0.113.42'
    assert data['origin'] != '127.0.0.1'

test_get_origin_uses_xff_when_present()

tests.name: test_origin_xff_overrides_remote_addr_decision_table
actions: Send GET /get WITHOUT X-Forwarded-For, assert origin == '127.0.0.1'
Send GET /get WITH X-Forwarded-For: 9.9.9.9, assert origin == '9.9.9.9'
expected: Results are different, proving XFF takes precedence
trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: decision table - XFF present vs absent
DT: catches mutation swapping XFF and remote_addr priority
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_origin_xff_overrides_remote_addr_decision_table():
    r_no_xff = client.get('/get')
    assert r_no_xff.status_code == 200
    origin_no_xff = r_no_xff.get_json()['origin']
    assert origin_no_xff == '127.0.0.1'

    r_with_xff = client.get('/get', headers={'X-Forwarded-For': '9.9.9.9'})
    assert r_with_xff.status_code == 200
    origin_with_xff = r_with_xff.get_json()['origin']
    assert origin_with_xff == '9.9.9.9'

    assert origin_no_xff != origin_with_xff

test_origin_xff_overrides_remote_addr_decision_table()

tests.name: test_all_echo_endpoints_have_origin_key
preconditions: All five echo endpoints are accessible
actions: Assert each returns 200 and has 'origin' key in JSON
expected: All five JSON responses contain 'origin' key with value '127.0.0.1'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: all echo endpoints must include origin
EP: covers all five endpoints in one sweep
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_all_echo_endpoints_have_origin_key():
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in endpoints:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"{method} {path} returned {r.status_code}"
        data = r.get_json()
        assert 'origin' in data, f"{method} {path} missing 'origin'"
        assert data['origin'] == '127.0.0.1', f"{method} {path} origin={data['origin']!r}"

test_all_echo_endpoints_have_origin_key()
